description: Defines classes and data structures for monitoring Wi-Fi stations, VAPs, radios, and database management within the prplMesh agent's fronthaul manager. Includes class declarations, enums, and member functions related to network monitoring and statistics.

classes.name: monitor_sta_node
classes.description: Represents a Wi-Fi station node with state, statistics, and configuration parameters.

classes.name: monitor_vap_node
classes.description: Represents a Virtual Access Point (VAP) node with interface info, statistics, and associated stations.

classes.name: monitor_radio_node
classes.description: Represents a radio interface with configuration, statistics, and AP metrics reporting info.

classes.name: monitor_db
classes.description: Main class managing the database of radios, VAPs, stations, and monitoring parameters.

methods.name: monitor_db::clear
methods.description: Resets the monitor database to initial state.

methods.name: monitor_vap_node::get_ipv4
methods.description: Returns the IPv4 address associated with the VAP.

methods.name: monitor_radio_node::get_rx_bit_rate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the receive bit rate for the radio.

methods.name: monitor_radio_node::get_tx_bit_rate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the transmit bit rate for the radio.

methods.name: monitor_sta_node::get_load_rx_phy_rate
methods.description: Returns the load received PHY rate.

methods.name: monitor_sta_node::get_load_tx_phy_rate
methods.description: Returns the load transmitted PHY rate.

methods.name: monitor_sta_node::get_load_rx_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns the load received bit rate.

methods.name: monitor_sta_node::get_load_tx_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns the load transmitted bit rate.
